### Fluor Signs EPC Contract with TeraWulf for Large-Scale Data Center Campus in Kentucky


November 4, 2026


IRVING, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Fluor Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.fluor.com&esheet=54635694&newsitemid=20261104906064&lan=en-US&anchor=Fluor+Corporation&index=1&md5=d949ce38d71e4a6f0ba4bf9fa2201dff) (NYSE: FLR) announced today that it has signed a definitive engineering, procurement and construction contract with TeraWulf for the development and construction of three data center buildings at the Justified Data Campus in Hawesville, Kentucky. Fluor expects to recognize the award in the fourth quarter upon finalization of pricing for the first two buildings. The contract is structured under which Fluor is responsible for cost overruns up to a percentage of its profit.


TeraWulf Justified Data Campus in Hawesville, Kentucky


“Fluor is proud to expand our partnership with TeraWulf and support the delivery of infrastructure needed to meet the rapidly growing demand for artificial intelligence and high-performance computing,” said Leo Kaid, President of Fluor’s Advanced Technologies & Life Sciences business line. “Our integrated engineering, procurement and construction capabilities, combined with our data center expertise and skilled workforce, position us to deliver this important project with a strong focus on safety, quality and schedule certainty.”


Fluor began supporting the project under a limited notice to proceed announced in March 2026.


Early works construction has already begun.
